maryam.heading: Hi, I'm Maryam
maryam.text:
*We have some amazing farms in Oxfordshire. As well as growing tasty veg, they are restoring our soils, creating climate resilience, and working with nature.*

The farmers I've spoken to have so much passion, but also struggle with the overtime and little pay, fighting to keep their farm business afloat. At the same time, the people I talked to in Oxford didn't know where to buy local veg and were keen to support local farms rather than supermarkets which exploit farms and consumers for profit.

Open on Sundays, I'm hoping to help bridge the gap between supermarkets and farmers markets, with easy packaging and pricing, and lots of advice and recipes if you're not used to seasonal veg. So if you're not sure about muddy carrots or want to find out how to cook a celeriac please do come down! And if you're passionate about local veg and want to chat all things agroecology, I'm more than happy to natter away at the counter.

Once you've actually 'tasted the difference' (to steal Sainsbury's brand line), it will be hard to beat local eggs, bread, and veg all harvested/baked the day before eating it.
